definitions.gloss: station name; the name of a railway station
definitions.explanation: The official name of a train or subway station, as shown on platform signs, route maps, and in announcements.

examples.japanese: {駅名|えきめい}を{確|たし}かめる。
{来年|らいねん}から{駅名|えきめい}が{変|か}わるそうだ。
examples.english: I hear the station name will change from next year.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{地名|ちめい}をそのまま{使|つか}った{駅名|えきめい}が{多|おお}いが、{近|ちか}くの{学校|がっこう}や{寺|てら}の{名前|なまえ}が{付|つ}くこともある。
examples.english: Many station names simply use the local place name, but sometimes the name of a nearby school or temple is used.

notes:
{駅|えき} (station) + {名|めい} (name). The {名|めい} suffix forms this whole family of words: {地名|ちめい} (place name), {社名|しゃめい} (company name), {書名|しょめい} (book title).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駅名|えきめい}を{確|たし}かめる: to check the station name
- {駅名|えきめい}が{変|か}わる: the station name changes
- {駅名|えきめい}{標|ひょう}: station name sign (on the platform)
- {駅名|えきめい}を{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる: to read out the station names

CULTURAL NOTE:
Station renaming is a small but regular news item in Japan, and companies sometimes pay for a station to carry their name. Because station names double as informal neighborhood names, a change affects addresses in conversation too.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地名|ちめい}: place name — the wider term; a station name often comes from one
- {路線名|ろせんめい}: line name — the name of the railway line rather than the stop
